title: I’m hanging on to his taw now for the past fortnight and I can’t get a penny out of him
html_source: The unnamed narrator is a debt collector, throwing the later stereotypes about Jewish people into comic relief.

anchor.text: I'm hanging on to his taw now for the past fortnight and I can't get a penny out of him
anchor.prefix:
off a hop-of-my-thumb by the name of Moses Herzog over there near Heytesbury street. 

 — Circumcised? says Joe. 

 — Ay, says I. A bit off the top. An old plumber named Geraghty.
